BREAKING:

🇵🇱 Poland launches special operation on the border with Kaliningrad amid Russian sabotage threats

Poland has deployed a high-readiness preventive security operation along its northeastern border following intelligence warnings of imminent Russian-backed sabotage.

The operation reinforces security across the Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship on the border with Kaliningrad and the Podlaskie Voivodeship on the border with Belarus.

Analysts warned that armed groups or operatives could attempt border incursions or orchestrate sabotage operations within Polish territory.
